SELECT dg.gb_dg_goods_name AS gbDgGoodsName, dg.gb_dg_nx_father_img AS gbDgNxFatherImg, dg.gb_dg_goods_standardname AS gbDgGoodsStandardname, gsr.gb_dgsr_gb_dis_goods_id AS gbDistributerGoodsId,
IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(gsr.gb_dgsr_subtotal), 1), 0) AS goodsProduceTotal
IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(gsr.gb_dgsr_subtotal), 1), 0) AS goodsWasteTotal
IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(gsr.gb_dgsr_subtotal), 1), 0) AS goodsLossTotal
IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(gsr.gb_dgsr_subtotal), 1), 0) AS goodsReturnTotal
IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(gsr.gb_dgsr_subtotal), 1), 0) AS goodsEmployeeMealTotal
IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(gsr.gb_dgsr_subtotal), 1), 0) AS goodsSubtotalTotal
FROM gb_department_goods_stock_reduce gsr LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_goods dg ON dg.gb_distributer_goods_id = gsr.gb_dgsr_gb_dis_goods_id WHERE 1=1
AND gsr.gb_dgsr_type = #{params.type}
AND gsr.gb_dgsr_date >= #{params.startDate}
AND gsr.gb_dgsr_date <= #{params.stopDate}
AND gsr.gb_dgsr_gb_distributer_id = #{params.disId}
AND gsr.gb_dgsr_gb_department_father_id = #{params.departmentFatherId}
AND gsr.gb_dgsr_gb_department_father_id in
#{fid}
GROUP BY gsr.gb_dgsr_gb_dis_goods_id, dg.gb_dg_goods_name
ORDER BY goodsProduceTotal DESC
ORDER BY goodsWasteTotal DESC
ORDER BY goodsLossTotal DESC
ORDER BY goodsReturnTotal DESC
ORDER BY goodsEmployeeMealTotal DESC
ORDER BY goodsSubtotalTotal DESC
LIMIT 10
